deviations.text: The TSV was built incrementally in one session: the gates and the pass-2/pass-3 stages were tightened after QA found problems (chat-turn free but: spelled meters like two-on-the-floor, tempo decades read as eras, invented tempo adjectives, dropped decade/meter information, adjective-list cuts). Logged records were re-validated against the final gates (--revalidate) and anything failing was regenerated, so every record in the log passes the final script. A from-scratch rerun of the final script is expected to give a corpus of the same kind but not byte-identical (sampled attempts). The action skips Step 1 because the TSV exists; Step 2 re-runs the audit and strict QA before training.

hypothesis.question: With a clean digit-free rewrite (only digit sentences edited, no chat-turn junk, no dangling fragments, digit-free sentences byte-identical), does c2p0 slot0 without digits change MusicCaps CFG0 or CFG3+neg?
hypothesis.why_rerun: slot4 (050/052) tied slot0, but its corpus was polluted: the slot4 rewrite passed no eos_token_id and its fallback stripped the LLM output instead of the original, leaving ~8,848 rows (40.9% of rewritten rows, 3.5% of the corpus) with chat-turn injection or 'tempo of.' fragments, and the LLM dropped 36-44% of digit-free sentences in rewritten rows. slot4 therefore did not isolate 'remove digits'.
hypothesis.what_moves: Only the digit-bearing sentences inside the 21644 / 251599 slot0 rows (8.6%) that contain an ASCII digit. Every other sentence and every other row is byte-identical to slot0 (asserted in the rewrite audit and in the action's Step 2).
hypothesis.not_controlled: Accepted rewrites come from Qwen2.5-Omni-3B text-only (greedy first, then temperature 0.3/0.5/0.7) behind hard gates; failures fall back to a deterministic lexicon + digit-clause drop of the original sentence. A sentence whose main clause is only the number is dropped.
hypothesis.seed_floor_caveat: CFG0 training-seed floor CLAP = 0.0042; 2x = 0.0084. Margins under 2x are ties.

canonical_cell.why: required by harn_guest.py completion evidence and puts the arm on the canonical CFG0 table

primary_cell.negative_prompt: low quality recording, noisy, amateur, distorted, muffled, poor fidelity, hiss, lo-fi
primary_cell.why: joins the recent arm-comparison table; not comparable to the canonical CFG0 table

decision_rule.rule: CFG0 CLAP >= 0.2113 counts as a win, 0.1945-0.2113 a tie, < 0.1945 a loss. The band is +/- 2x the CFG0 CLAP training-seed floor (0.0042).

row_last_resort.src: The description of the music in 2-5 sentences.

corpus_build.passes: pass1 minimal digit removal (greedy + 3 sampled) -> pass2 restructure (verb forms from source participles only) -> pass3 7B instruct on the same gates -> deterministic fallback on the ORIGINAL sentence: token lexicon, number-span cut after "<adj> tempo", digit-clause drop, phrase-comma prefix, else drop the sentence
corpus_build.qa: qa_slot4v2_corpus.py --strict passed (0 hard failures); manual review of >200 sampled sentences across all methods
